name: Execution of Suspicious File Type Extension
description:
Detects whether the image specified in a process creation event doesn't refer to an ".exe" (or other known executable extension) file. This can be caused by process ghosting or other unorthodox methods to start a process.
This rule might require some initial baselining to align with some third party tooling in the user environment.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (NOT (process.executable:(*.bin OR *.cgi OR *.com OR *.exe OR *.scr OR *.tmp))) AND (NOT ((process.executable:(System OR Registry OR MemCompression OR vmmem)) OR process.executable:*\:\\Windows\\Installer\\MSI* OR process.executable:*\:\\Windows\\System32\\DriverStore\\FileRepository\\* OR (process.executable:*\:\\Config.Msi\\* AND (process.executable:(*.rbf OR *.rbs))) OR (process.parent.executable:*\:\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR process.executable:*\:\\Windows\\Temp\\*) OR process.executable:*\:\\$Extend\\$Deleted\\* OR (process.executable:(\- OR "")) OR (NOT _exists_:process.executable))) AND (NOT (process.parent.executable:*\:\\ProgramData\\Avira\\* OR (process.executable:*NVIDIA\\NvBackend\\* AND process.executable:*.dat) OR ((process.executable:(*\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\WINPAKPRO\\* OR *\:\\Program\ Files\\WINPAKPRO\\*)) AND process.executable:*.ngn) OR (process.executable:(*\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\MyQ\\Server\\pcltool.dll OR *\:\\Program\ Files\\MyQ\\Server\\pcltool.dll)) OR (process.executable:*\\AppData\\Local\\Packages\\* AND process.executable:*\\LocalState\\rootfs\\*) OR process.executable:*\\LZMA_EXE OR process.executable:*\:\\Program\ Files\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\* OR (process.parent.executable:C\:\\Windows\\System32\\services.exe AND process.executable:*com.docker.service)))
